"""Print each close record's evidence block shape (keys and value kinds), and whether it has one."""
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import yaml

root = Path("/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-64")
full = len(sys.argv) > 1
for md in sorted((root / "docs/close").rglob("CL-*.md")):
    text = md.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    lines = text.split("\n")
    end = lines.index("---", 1)
    front = yaml.safe_load("\n".join(lines[1:end]))
    ev = front.get("evidence", "<absent>")
    if ev == "<absent>" or ev is None:
        print(md.relative_to(root), "evidence:", ev, "keys:", sorted(front))
        continue
    shape = {k: type(v).__name__ for k, v in ev.items()}
    print(md.relative_to(root), json.dumps(shape))
    if full and md.parent.name in sys.argv[1:]:
        print(json.dumps(ev, indent=1, default=str)[:4000])
